metadata.title: Nvidia Stock: Latest Deal More Confusing Than Ever—Just Don’t Call It ‘Circular Financing’<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Nvidia-Backed Anthropic Inks $35 Billion Deal. Just Don’t Call It ‘Circular Financing’
Nvidia’s appetite to act as banker and investor for the artificial-intelligence ecosystem seems endless. Its most recent deal is a doozy, even by the chip maker’s standards.
